facts.name: Policy Identification
facts.sentence: The policy number is MHF-JVUL-2026-6120.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Date
facts.sentence: The policy date is April 10, 2026.

facts.name: Insured Party Name
facts.sentence: The name of the insured party is Ethan Michael Ruiz.

facts.name: Insured Party DOB
facts.sentence: The date of birth of the insured party is December 6, 2018.

facts.name: Male Insured Party
facts.sentence: The gender of the insured party is male.

facts.name: Age at Issue: 7 Years
facts.sentence: The age of the insured party at issue is 7.

facts.name: Juvenile Standard Classification
facts.sentence: The class of the insured party is Juvenile Standard.

facts.name: Initial Face Amount
facts.sentence: The initial face amount of the policy is $250,000.

facts.name: Planned Annual Premium
facts.sentence: The planned annual premium for the policy is $4,200.

facts.name: Level Death Benefit Option
facts.sentence: The death benefit option selected is Option I (Level).

facts.name: Custodial Owner Designation
facts.sentence: The policy owner is Sofia Elena Ruiz.

facts.name: Custodial Ownership Role
facts.sentence: The policy owner holds the role of custodian for Ethan Michael Ruiz.

facts.name: Ownership Transfer Age
facts.sentence: The ownership transfer age specified in the policy is 21.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary is Sofia Elena Ruiz.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Share
facts.sentence: The percentage share of the primary beneficiary is 100%.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiary is the estate of the insured.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Share
facts.sentence: The percentage share of the contingent beneficiary is 100%.

facts.name: Definitions in Policy Section 1
facts.sentence: Section 1 of the policy contains Definitions.

facts.name: Juvenile Owner Definition
facts.sentence: Definition 1.1 states that 'Juvenile Owner' means the minor whose life is insured under this policy.

facts.name: Custodial Owner Definition
facts.sentence: Definition 1.2 states that 'Custodial Owner' means the adult owner exercising rights until ownership transfers under the Ownership Transfer provision.

facts.name: Maturity Transfer Date Definition
facts.sentence: Definition 1.3 defines 'Maturity Transfer Date' as the policy anniversary nearest the juvenile owner's 21st birthday.

facts.name: Insured Insurability Rider Definition
facts.sentence: Definition 1.4 refers to 'Insured Insurability Rider' as the option rider permitting future face amount purchases on stated option dates.

facts.name: Investment Options Overview
facts.sentence: Section 2 of the policy covers Investment Options.

facts.name: Investment Allocation Options
facts.sentence: Net premiums may be allocated among Growth and Income, Education Savings Allocation, Core Bond, and Stable Interest investment options.

facts.name: Initial Investment Allocation
facts.sentence: The initial allocation of net premiums is 40% to Growth and Income.

facts.name: Initial Education Savings Allocation
facts.sentence: The initial allocation of net premiums is 25% to Education Savings Allocation.

facts.name: Initial Core Bond Allocation
facts.sentence: The initial allocation of net premiums is 20% to Core Bond.

facts.name: Initial Stable Interest Allocation
facts.sentence: The initial allocation of net premiums is 15% to Stable Interest.

facts.name: Authorization Requirement Before Maturity
facts.sentence: Parental or custodial authorization may be required for all transfer and withdrawal requests prior to the Maturity Transfer Date.

facts.name: Policy Charges Overview
facts.sentence: Section 3 of the policy outlines Charges.

facts.name: Premium Load Rate
facts.sentence: The premium load charged by the insurer is 4.75%.

facts.name: Mortality and Expense Charge Rate
facts.sentence: The Mortality and Expense (M&E) Charge is 0.80% per annum.

facts.name: Daily M&E Charge Deduction
facts.sentence: The M&E Charge is deducted daily.

facts.name: Monthly Policy Charge
facts.sentence: The monthly policy charge is $8.

facts.name: Cost of Insurance Based on Juvenile Rates
facts.sentence: The cost of insurance is assessed monthly based on juvenile rates.

facts.name: Annual Fund Expenses Range
facts.sentence: Fund expenses range between 0.22% and 0.88% annually.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Period
facts.sentence: A surrender charge applies during year 1 through year 5 of the policy.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Rate (Years 1–5)
facts.sentence: The surrender charge rate for years 1–5 is 6%.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Rate Years 6–8
facts.sentence: The surrender charge rate for years 6–8 is 3%.

facts.name: Annual Fund Expense Range
facts.sentence: Annual fund expenses range from 0.22% to 0.88%.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: Years 1–5
facts.sentence: A surrender charge of 6% applies during policy years 1 to 5.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: Years 6–8
facts.sentence: A surrender charge of 3% applies during policy years 6 to 8.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Exemption After Year 9
facts.sentence: No surrender charge applies in policy year 9 and beyond.

facts.name: Level Death Benefit Selected
facts.sentence: Option I – Level Death Benefit is currently selected.

facts.name: Ownership Transfer Condition
facts.sentence: Ownership transfers to the insured upon the Maturity Transfer Date if permitted by law.

facts.name: Ownership Transfer Requirement
facts.sentence: Ownership transfer to the insured is subject to submission of required forms.

facts.name: Ownership Transfer Limitation
facts.sentence: If ownership transfer cannot legally occur at age 21, the custodial owner remains the owner.

facts.name: Custodial Ownership Continuity
facts.sentence: The custodial owner holds ownership until the earliest lawful transfer date.

facts.name: Insured Insurability Rider Benefit
facts.sentence: Face amount increases under the Insured Insurability Rider do not require evidence of insurability on stated option dates.

facts.name: Payor Benefit Rider Included
facts.sentence: Payor Benefit Rider is included in the policy.

facts.name: Guaranteed Purchase Option Rider
facts.sentence: Guaranteed Purchase Option Rider is included in the policy.

facts.name: Education Access Endorsement Included
facts.sentence: Education Access Endorsement is included in the policy.

facts.name: Loan Availability Restriction
facts.sentence: Policy loans are not available before policy year 3.

facts.name: Max Loan Limit: 85% Surrender Value
facts.sentence: Maximum policy loan amount is 85% of the surrender value.

facts.name: Fixed Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Policy loans carry a fixed interest rate of 5.0%.

facts.name: Minimum Withdrawal Amount
facts.sentence: Minimum partial withdrawal amount is $500.

facts.name: Withdrawal Consent Requirement
facts.sentence: Prior to ownership transfer, withdrawals require custodial consent.

facts.name: Withdrawals Reduce Face Amount
facts.sentence: Withdrawals reduce the face amount of the policy.

facts.name: Withdrawal Impact on Riders
facts.sentence: Withdrawals may impair rider guarantees.

facts.name: Withdrawal Floor Limit
facts.sentence: No withdrawal may reduce the face amount below $50,000.

facts.name: Policy Lapse Condition
facts.sentence: Lapse occurs when the account value is insufficient to cover charges.

facts.name: Grace Period Duration
facts.sentence: Grace period duration is 61 days after notice of lapse.

facts.name: Reinstatement Requires Insurability Proof
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within 3 years requires evidence of insurability on the insured.

facts.name: Rider Waiver of Evidence Requirement
facts.sentence: Evidence of insurability requirement can be waived if applicable rider terms allow.

facts.name: Suicide Benefit Limitation
facts.sentence: Suicide death benefit liability is limited to premiums paid minus withdrawals if death occurs within 2 years of issue.

facts.name: Suicide Benefit Limitation Post-Reinstatement
facts.sentence: Suicide death benefit liability is limited to premiums paid minus withdrawals if death occurs within 2 years of reinstatement.

facts.name: Policy Incontestability After 2 Years
facts.sentence: This policy becomes incontestable after 2 years.

facts.name: Incontestability Exceptions
facts.sentence: Exceptions to incontestability apply only for nonpayment of charges.

facts.name: Investment Risk Ownership
facts.sentence: The policy owner bears investment risk for variable portfolios.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Details
facts.sentence: This policy is issued through Maple Harbor Variable Account J.

facts.name: Market Fluctuations in Variable Portfolios
facts.sentence: Account values under variable portfolios are subject to market fluctuations.

facts.name: Policy Lapse Due to Nonpayment
facts.sentence: Nonpayment of charges may result in policy lapse.

facts.name: Policy Owner Investment Risk
facts.sentence: The policy owner bears investment risk for variable portfolios.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Entity
facts.sentence: This policy is issued through Maple Harbor Variable Account J.

facts.name: Variable Portfolio Risk Disclosure
facts.sentence: Account values under variable portfolios are not guaranteed.

facts.name: Read Prospectus Before Allocating
facts.sentence: The policyholder should read the prospectus before making allocations.

facts.name: Issuing Company Identification
facts.sentence: Maple Harbor Family Life Insurance Company is the issuing company.

facts.name: Index-Overlay Variable UL Policy
facts.sentence: The policy is named INDEX-OVERLAY VARIABLE UNIVERSAL LIFE POLICY.

facts.name: Issuing Company Identification
facts.sentence: The issuing company is Granite Ridge Life and Annuity Company.

facts.name: Policy Identification
facts.sentence: The policy number is GRL-IOVUL-2026-7035.

facts.name: Policy Effective Date
facts.sentence: The policy date is April 10, 2026.

facts.name: Insured Party Name
facts.sentence: The insured party's name is Nathan Cole Whitaker.

facts.name: Insured Party DOB
facts.sentence: The insured party's date of birth is March 27, 1982.

facts.name: Insured Gender
facts.sentence: The insured party's gender is male.

facts.name: Age at Issue: 44
facts.sentence: The insured party's age at issue is 44.

facts.name: Preferred Insured Classification
facts.sentence: The insured party's class is Preferred.

facts.name: Initial Face Amount
facts.sentence: The initial face amount of the policy is $900,000.

facts.name: Planned Annual Premium
facts.sentence: The planned annual premium is $10,800.

facts.name: Death Benefit Option II
facts.sentence: The death benefit option elected is Option II.

facts.name: Death Benefit Calculation: Option II
facts.sentence: Option II provides a death benefit equal to the sum of the face amount plus the account value.

facts.name: Index Overlay Election
facts.sentence: An Index Overlay Program is elected for this policy.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary is Lauren Paige Whitaker.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Share
facts.sentence: Lauren Paige Whitaker’s share of the primary beneficiary designation is 100%.

facts.name: Estate as Contingent Beneficiary
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiary is the Estate of insured.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The estate of the insured’s share of the contingent beneficiary designation is 100%.

facts.name: Definition of Index Overlay Sleeve
facts.sentence: Section 1 defines 'Index Overlay Sleeve' as the rules-based managed sleeve that reallocates among underlying variable portfolios using a published volatility-control methodology.

facts.name: Base Portfolio Definition
facts.sentence: Section 1 defines 'Base Portfolio' as the underlying portfolio selected by the owner to support the Index Overlay Sleeve.

facts.name: Overlay Reset Date Definition
facts.sentence: Section 1 defines 'Overlay Reset Date' as the monthly date on which the sleeve may rebalance pursuant to the overlay program.

facts.name: Protected Cash Position Definition
facts.sentence: Section 1 defines 'Protected Cash Position' as the short-term reserve allocation used by the overlay methodology during market stress periods.

facts.name: Premium Investment Options
facts.sentence: Section 2 states that net premiums may be allocated among U.S. Broad Market, International Equity, Core Bond, Managed Risk Overlay Sleeve, and Fixed Account options.

facts.name: Current Allocation Breakdown
facts.sentence: Current allocation is 50% Managed Risk Overlay Sleeve.

facts.name: Current U.S. Broad Market Allocation
facts.sentence: Current allocation is 20% U.S. Broad Market.

facts.name: International Equity Allocation
facts.sentence: Current allocation is 10% International Equity.

facts.name: Core Bond Allocation
facts.sentence: Current allocation is 10% Core Bond.

facts.name: Fixed Account Allocation
facts.sentence: Current allocation is 10% Fixed Account.

facts.name: Managed Risk Sleeve Classification
facts.sentence: The Managed Risk Overlay Sleeve is not an indexed universal life account.

facts.name: Managed Risk Overlay Sleeve Classification
facts.sentence: The Managed Risk Overlay Sleeve remains part of the variable separate account.

facts.name: Overlay Methodology Termination Clause
facts.sentence: Granite Ridge Life and Annuity Company may terminate or replace the overlay methodology if the index sponsor discontinues the strategy.

facts.name: Overlay Methodology Termination Clause
facts.sentence: Granite Ridge Life and Annuity Company may terminate or replace the overlay methodology if licensing for the strategy is no longer available.

facts.name: Premium Load Charge Rate
facts.sentence: Premium Load charge is 4.00%.

facts.name: M&E Charge Rate
facts.sentence: M&E Charge is 0.88% annually.

facts.name: Daily M&E Charge Deduction
facts.sentence: M&E Charge is deducted daily.

facts.name: Monthly Policy Fee
facts.sentence: Monthly Policy Charge is $13.

facts.name: Cost of Insurance Calculation
facts.sentence: Cost of Insurance is calculated monthly based on the net amount at risk.

facts.name: Zero Fund Expenses
facts.sentence: Fund Expenses are zero.

facts.name: Annual Deduction Rate: 88%
facts.sentence: The annual deduction rate is 88%, applied daily.

facts.name: Monthly Policy Charge
facts.sentence: The monthly policy charge is $13.

facts.name: Cost of Insurance Calculation
facts.sentence: The cost of insurance is calculated monthly based on the net amount at risk.

facts.name: Annual Fund Expenses Range
facts.sentence: Fund expenses range from 0.18% to 1.00% annually.

facts.name: Overlay Program Charge
facts.sentence: An overlay program charge of 0.20% applies annually on values in the Managed Risk Overlay Sleeve.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: Years 1–4
facts.sentence: A surrender charge of 7% applies during years 1 through 4.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: Years 5–6
facts.sentence: A surrender charge of 4% applies during years 5 through 6.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: Years 7–8
facts.sentence: A surrender charge of 2% applies during years 7 through 8.

facts.name: No Surrender Charge After Year 9
facts.sentence: No surrender charge applies in year 9 or later.

facts.name: Face Plus Selected
facts.sentence: Option II – Face Plus Account Value is currently selected.

facts.name: Death Benefit Fluctuation
facts.sentence: The death benefit under Option II fluctuates with the account value.

facts.name: Death Benefit Fluctuation Due to Legal Corridors
facts.sentence: The death benefit under Option II may also vary due to legal corridor requirements.

facts.name: Annual Switch Limit – Option II to I
facts.sentence: A switch from Option II to Option I can occur once per policy year.

facts.name: Option Change Restrictions
facts.sentence: Changing from Option II to Option I is subject to administrative rules set by the insurer.

facts.name: Switching Fee for Benefit Options
facts.sentence: A $35 processing fee applies for switching from Option II to Option I.

facts.name: Insurer Right to Require Insurability Proof
facts.sentence: The insurer reserves the right to request evidence of insurability for any proposed increase in death benefit.

facts.name: Unemployment Premium Deferral Rider
facts.sentence: The Unemployment Premium Deferral Rider is included as a rider feature.

facts.name: Systematic Transfer Program Feature
facts.sentence: The Systematic Transfer Program is offered as a program feature.

facts.name: Volatility Control Disclosure
facts.sentence: Volatility Control Disclosure is provided as part of the product features.

facts.name: Loan Limit Based on Surrender Value
facts.sentence: Policy loans are capped at 90% of the surrender value.

facts.name: Variable Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The interest rate for policy loans is variable at 5.15%.

facts.name: Loan Distribution Mechanism
facts.sentence: Loaned amounts are removed proportionately from all investment options.

facts.name: Minimum Partial Withdrawal Amount
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals have a minimum limit of $1,000.

facts.name: Partial Withdrawal Limits
facts.sentence: Maximum partial withdrawals equal the account value minus surrender charges and loan reserve.

facts.name: Partial Withdrawal Processing Fee
facts.sentence: A $25 processing fee applies to each partial withdrawal.

facts.name: Withdrawals Reduce Overlay Effectiveness
facts.sentence: Withdrawals may reduce the effectiveness of the overlay program.

facts.name: Loan Impact on Overlay Program
facts.sentence: Loans may reduce the effectiveness of the overlay program.

facts.name: Withdrawals Affect Future Rebalancing
facts.sentence: Withdrawals may affect the value available for future rebalancing.

facts.name: Loan Impact on Rebalancing
facts.sentence: Loans may affect the value available for future rebalancing.

facts.name: Policy Lapse Condition
facts.sentence: This policy lapses if the account value is insufficient to cover monthly deductions after the grace period ends.

facts.name: Lapse Notice Period
facts.sentence: At least 30 days' notice will be sent prior to policy lapse.

facts.name: Reinstatement Requires Insurability Proof
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within five years requires submission of evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Reinstatement Payment Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within five years requires payment of all outstanding required amounts.

facts.name: Reinstatement Requirements
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within five years requires compliance with current rules at the time of reinstatement.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: If death results from suicide within two years of policy issuance, liability is limited to premiums paid.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Withdrawal Impact
facts.sentence: If death results from suicide within two years of policy issuance, liabilities exclude withdrawals made.

facts.name: Suicide Death Liability Limitation
facts.sentence: If death results from suicide within two years of policy issuance, liabilities exclude debts owed.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Entity
facts.sentence: This policy is issued through Granite Ridge Separate Account V.

facts.name: Overlay Sleeve Integration
facts.sentence: The overlay sleeve is part of the variable account.

facts.name: Overlay Sleeve Not a Bank Product
facts.sentence: The overlay sleeve is not a bank product.

facts.name: Overlay Sleeve Not a Deposit
facts.sentence: The overlay sleeve is not a deposit.

facts.name: Suicide Death Limitation
facts.sentence: If death occurs by suicide within 2 years, liability is limited to premiums paid less withdrawals and debt.

facts.name: Owner Bears Investment Risk
facts.sentence: The owner bears all investment risk for the variable account.

facts.name: Owner Bears Overlay Sleeve Risk
facts.sentence: The owner bears all investment risk for the overlay sleeve.

facts.name: Index Sponsor Liability Exclusion
facts.sentence: No index sponsor is liable for policy performance.

facts.name: Index Sponsor Liability Exclusion
facts.sentence: No index sponsor is liable for charges.

facts.name: Index Sponsor Liability Exclusion
facts.sentence: No index sponsor is liable for death benefits.

facts.name: Review Prospectus Before Investing
facts.sentence: Read the prospectus before investing.

facts.name: Review Overlay Supplement
facts.sentence: Read the overlay supplement before investing.

facts.name: Policy Issuer
facts.sentence: Granite Ridge Life and Annuity Company is the issuer of this policy.

facts.name: Company Location
facts.sentence: Granite Ridge Life and Annuity Company is located in Denver, Colorado.

facts.name: Chief Insurance Officer Oversight
facts.sentence: The Chief Insurance Officer oversees this policy.

facts.name: Charitable Allocation Instruction Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Charitable Allocation Instruction' refers to the beneficiary allocation direction filed by the owner naming one or more qualified charities.

facts.name: Legacy Grant Benefit Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Legacy Grant Benefit' refers to the portion of death proceeds designated to a qualified charitable beneficiary.

facts.name: Family Benefit Portion Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Family Benefit Portion' refers to the balance of death proceeds payable to non-charitable beneficiaries.

facts.name: Qualified Charity Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Qualified Charity' refers to an organization acceptable to Heritage Beacon Life Insurance Company and identified in their records as eligible to receive proceeds.

facts.name: Investment Allocation Options
facts.sentence: Net premiums may be allocated among Sustainable Global Equity, Dividend Income, Intermediate Bond, Social Impact Allocation, and Fixed Account investment options.

facts.sentence: The current allocation of net premiums is 30% to Sustainable Global Equity.

facts.name: Current Dividend Income Allocation

facts.name: Fixed Account Allocation
facts.sentence: The current allocation of net premiums is 10% to Fixed Account.

facts.name: Annual Stewardship Reporting
facts.sentence: The owner may enroll in annual stewardship reporting that summarizes charitable beneficiary designations and policy values.

facts.name: Premium Load Charge Rate
facts.sentence: The premium load charge is 4.80%.

facts.name: Mortality & Expense Charge Details
facts.sentence: The Mortality & Expense (M&E) charge is 0.78% per year, deducted daily.

facts.name: Monthly Admin Fee
facts.sentence: The monthly administrative charge is $11.

facts.name: Cost of Insurance Calculation
facts.sentence: The cost of insurance is calculated monthly based on the net amount at risk.

facts.name: Annual Fund Expense Range
facts.sentence: Fund expenses range between 0.24% and 0.98% annually.

facts.name: Insurance Cost Based on Net Risk
facts.sentence: Monthly insurance cost is based on the net amount at risk.

facts.name: Annual Fund Expenses Range
facts.sentence: Fund expenses range from 0.24% to 0.98% annually.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: Years 1–2
facts.sentence: A surrender charge of 8% applies in years 1 and 2.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Years 3–4
facts.sentence: A surrender charge of 6% applies in years 3 and 4.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: Years 5–6
facts.sentence: A surrender charge of 4% applies in years 5 and 6.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: Years 7–8
facts.sentence: A surrender charge of 2% applies in years 7 and 8.

facts.name: No Surrender Charge After Year 9
facts.sentence: No surrender charge applies in year 9 and beyond.

facts.name: Level Death Benefit Selected
facts.sentence: Option I – Level Death Benefit is currently selected.

facts.name: Charitable Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The policy owner may designate fixed percentages of the death benefit to one or more qualified charitable beneficiaries.

facts.name: Charitable Beneficiary Disposition Rule
facts.sentence: If a designated charitable beneficiary no longer exists at death and no replacement instruction is on file, that share is payable to the remaining primary beneficiaries pro rata.

facts.name: Charitable Allocation Updates
facts.sentence: Changes in charitable allocation instructions take effect only upon recording by the insurer during the insured's lifetime.

facts.name: Legacy Match Endorsement Rider
facts.sentence: Legacy Match Endorsement is a rider available under Section 5.

facts.name: Terminal Illness Rider Availability
facts.sentence: Terminal Illness Acceleration Rider is a rider available under Section 5.

facts.name: Stewardship Successor Owner Rider
facts.sentence: Stewardship Successor Owner Provision is a rider available under Section 5.

facts.name: Maximum Policy Loan Limit
facts.sentence: Policy loans can be up to 90% of the surrender value.

facts.name: Fixed Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Policy loans carry a fixed interest rate of 5.0%.

facts.name: Loan Impact on Beneficiaries
facts.sentence: Policy loans reduce all beneficiary shares proportionately unless a specific assignment is on file providing otherwise.

facts.name: Minimum Partial Withdrawal Amount
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals have a minimum amount of $1,000.

facts.name: Partial Withdrawal Fee
facts.sentence: A processing fee of $30 applies to partial withdrawals.

facts.name: Partial Withdrawals Reduce Face Amount
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals reduce the face amount of the policy.

facts.name: Withdrawal Impact on Legacy Match
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals may reduce eligibility for the Legacy Match Endorsement.

facts.name: Charitable Beneficiary Rights Limitation
facts.sentence: No charitable beneficiary acquires ownership rights solely by being named as a beneficiary.

facts.name: Policy Lapse Condition
facts.sentence: Lapse occurs if the account value is insufficient to support monthly deductions.

facts.name: Pre-Lapse Notice Requirement
facts.sentence: Notice will be provided before lapse occurs.

facts.name: Grace Period After Lapse Notice
facts.sentence: A 61-day grace period is offered after lapse notification.

facts.name: Reinstatement Requires Insurability Proof
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within 5 years requires evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Requirements
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within 5 years requires payment of required amounts with interest.

facts.name: Suicide Benefit Limitation
facts.sentence: Suicide liability is limited to premiums paid minus withdrawals if death occurs within 2 years.

facts.name: Policy Incontestability After 2 Years
facts.sentence: The policy becomes incontestable after 2 years, except for nonpayment.

facts.name: Non-Guaranteed Returns
facts.sentence: Investment performance is not guaranteed.

facts.name: Investment Risk Impact
facts.sentence: Investment performance may reduce account value.

facts.name: IDE Liability Cap Within 2 Years
facts.sentence: Liability under IDE is limited to premiums paid minus withdrawals if such withdrawals occur within two years.

facts.name: Policy Incontestability After Two Years
facts.sentence: This policy becomes incontestable after two years, except in cases of nonpayment.

facts.name: Unpredictable Investment Returns
facts.sentence: Investment performance is not guaranteed.

facts.name: Account Value Reduction Risk
facts.sentence: Investment performance may result in a reduction of account value.

facts.name: Policy Issuance via Separate Account
facts.sentence: This policy is issued through Heritage Beacon Separate Account C.

facts.name: Owner Bears Investment Risk
facts.sentence: The owner bears investment risk for all variable portfolios.

facts.name: Read Prospectus Before Investing
facts.sentence: Individuals should read the prospectus before making any investments.

facts.sentence: Heritage Beacon Life Insurance Company is responsible for issuing this policy.

facts.name: Headquarters Location

facts.name: Monthly Policy Charge
facts.sentence: The monthly policy charge is $16.

facts.name: Cost of Insurance Calculation
facts.sentence: Cost of Insurance is calculated monthly based on the net amount at risk.

facts.sentence: Fund Expenses range between 0.19% and 0.92% annually.

facts.name: Surrender Charges Apply
facts.sentence: Surrender charges apply.

facts.name: Cost Based on Net Risk
facts.sentence: Monthly insurance cost is based on the net amount at risk.

facts.name: Annual Fund Expenses Range
facts.sentence: Fund expenses range between 0.19% and 0.92% annually.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: Years 1–3

facts.name: Surrender Charge: Years 4–5
facts.sentence: A surrender charge of 5% applies during years 4 through 5.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: Years 6–7
facts.sentence: A surrender charge of 3% applies during years 6 through 7.

facts.name: No Surrender Charge After Year 8
facts.sentence: No surrender charge applies in year 8 or thereafter.

facts.name: Level Death Benefit Selected
facts.sentence: Option I – Level Death Benefit is currently selected.

facts.name: Beneficiary Designation Rights
facts.sentence: Death proceeds are payable to the beneficiary designated by the Entity Owner.

facts.name: Death Proceeds Subject to Assignments
facts.sentence: Payment of death proceeds is subject to any existing assignment.

facts.name: Death Proceeds & Buy-Sell Condition
facts.sentence: Payment of death proceeds is subject to the Buy-Sell Endorsement.

facts.name: Insured Ownership Rights
facts.sentence: No individual insured under this policy holds ownership rights simply due to being insured.

facts.name: Face Amount Change Requirement
facts.sentence: The face amount can only be changed upon written request by the Entity Owner.

facts.name: Face Amount Increase Requirement
facts.sentence: An increase in the face amount requires evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Key Person Replacement Rider
facts.sentence: The Key Person Replacement Expense Rider is included.

facts.name: Buy-Sell Agreement Inclusion
facts.sentence: The Buy-Sell Agreement Endorsement is included.

facts.name: Change of Control Provision
facts.sentence: The Change of Control Provision is included.

facts.name: Maximum Policy Loan Limit
facts.sentence: Policy loans may reach up to 90% of the surrender value.

facts.name: Fixed Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Policy loan interest rate is fixed at 5.35%.

facts.name: Loan Authorization Requirement
facts.sentence: Policy loans require the signature of an Authorized Officer.

facts.name: Minimum Withdrawal Amount
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals have a minimum amount of $2,000.

facts.name: Partial Withdrawal Fee
facts.sentence: A processing fee of $50 applies to partial withdrawals.

facts.name: Partial Withdrawals Reduce Face Amount
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals reduce the face amount of the policy.

facts.name: Withdrawal Impact on Funding
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals may impair the Buy-Sell funding objectives.

facts.name: Lender Priority Over Beneficiary Changes
facts.sentence: Any collateral assignment filed by a lender takes precedence over subsequent beneficiary changes.

facts.name: Lender Priority Limitation
facts.sentence: The extent of the lender’s priority is limited to their interest in the policy.

facts.name: Policy Lapse Condition
facts.sentence: Lapse occurs when the account value is insufficient to cover charges and the grace period ends.

facts.name: Grace Period After Notice
facts.sentence: A 61-day grace period applies after notice of non-payment.

facts.name: Reinstatement Evidence Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within three years requires evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Reinstatement Payment Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within three years requires payment of required amounts.

facts.name: Reinstatement Requirement Proof
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within three years requires proof of continued entity authority.

facts.name: Suicide Clause Limitation
facts.sentence: If death results from suicide within two years, liability is limited to premiums paid minus withdrawals and debt.

facts.name: Entity Owner Bears Investment Risk
facts.sentence: The Entity Owner bears investment risk.

facts.name: Policy Compliance Limitation
facts.sentence: This policy does not guarantee compliance with the terms of any separate buy-sell agreement.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Channel
facts.sentence: This policy is issued through IronGate Separate Account BL.

facts.name: Non-Guaranteed Account Values
facts.sentence: Variable account values are not guaranteed.

facts.name: Review Prospectus Carefully
facts.sentence: Read the prospectus carefully.

facts.name: Review Business Endorsements
facts.sentence: Read any business endorsement carefully.

facts.name: Entity Owner Investment Risk
facts.sentence: The Entity Owner bears investment risk.

facts.name: Coverage Limitation
facts.sentence: The policy's coverage is limited to premiums paid less withdrawals and debt.

facts.name: Policy Limitations on Buy-Sell Agreements
facts.sentence: No representation is made that this policy alone satisfies the terms of any separate buy-sell agreement.

facts.name: Company Location
facts.sentence: IronGate Business Life Insurance Company is located in Minneapolis, Minnesota.

facts.name: Policy Execution by IronGate
facts.sentence: IronGate Business Life Insurance Company executed this policy.

facts.name: Senior Variable UL Policy
facts.sentence: The policy type is Senior Variable Universal Life.

facts.name: Issuing Insurer Identification
facts.sentence: The issuing company is SilverOak Assurance Life Company.

facts.name: Policy Identification
facts.sentence: The policy number is SOA-SVUL-2026-1019.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Date
facts.sentence: The policy date is April 10, 2026.

facts.name: Insured Party Identity
facts.sentence: The insured party's name is Eleanor Mae Donnelly.

facts.name: Insured Party DOB
facts.sentence: The insured party's date of birth is September 21, 1958.

facts.name: Insured Gender Specification
facts.sentence: The insured party's gender is female.

facts.name: Age at Issue: 67
facts.sentence: The insured party's age at issue is 67.

facts.name: Insured Classification: Standard
facts.sentence: The insured party's class is Standard.

facts.name: Initial Face Amount
facts.sentence: The initial face amount of the policy is $600,000.

facts.name: Planned Annual Premium
facts.sentence: The planned annual premium is $14,500.

facts.name: Level Death Benefit Option
facts.sentence: The death benefit option selected is Option I (Level).

facts.name: Estate Equalization Purpose
facts.sentence: The policy objective is estate equalization.

facts.name: Final Expense Liquidity
facts.sentence: The policy objective is final expense liquidity.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary is Karen Louise Donnelly with a 50% share.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Share
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary is Patrick Sean Donnelly with a 50% share.

facts.name: Estate Contingency Beneficiary
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiary is the Estate of insured with a 100% share.

facts.name: Senior Lapse Protection Test Definition
facts.sentence: Section 1 defines 'Senior Lapse Protection Test' as the premium funding test shown on the policy data page for maintenance of guaranteed coverage.

facts.name: Assisted Admin Service Definition
facts.sentence: Section 1 defines 'Assisted Administration Service' as the service under which duplicate lapse and premium notices are sent to a named third party.

facts.name: Fixed Medical Expense Rider Definition
facts.sentence: Section 1 defines 'Fixed Medical Expense Rider' as the optional rider that may accelerate a portion of death benefit upon certain chronic or terminal illness conditions described in the rider.

facts.name: Value Preservation Account Definition
facts.sentence: Section 1 defines 'Value Preservation Account' as the conservative allocation option designed for lower volatility but without guarantee except as stated for the Fixed Account.

facts.name: Premium Allocation Options
facts.sentence: Section 2 states that net premiums may be allocated among Dividend Income, Conservative Allocation, Short-Term Bond, Value Preservation, and Fixed Account options.

facts.name: Current Investment Allocation
facts.sentence: Current allocation is 15% Dividend Income.

facts.name: Current Investment Allocation
facts.sentence: Current allocation is 25% Conservative Allocation.

facts.name: Current Short-Term Bond Allocation
facts.sentence: Current allocation is 25% Short-Term Bond.

facts.name: Current Value Preservation Allocation
facts.sentence: Current allocation is 20% Value Preservation.

facts.name: Current Fixed Account Allocation
facts.sentence: Current allocation is 15% Fixed Account.

facts.name: Transfer Frequency Limits
facts.sentence: The insurer may impose lower transfer frequency limits for policies issued under Senior Series administration rules.

facts.name: Premium Load Charge
facts.sentence: Premium Load charge is 3.90%.

facts.name: M&E Charge Details
facts.sentence: M&E Charge is 0.68% annually and is deducted daily.

facts.name: Monthly Policy Charge
facts.sentence: Monthly Policy Charge is $9.

facts.name: Cost of Insurance Calculation
facts.sentence: Cost of Insurance is calculated monthly based on attained age and net amount at risk.

facts.name: Fund Expenses Range
facts.sentence: Fund Expenses range from 0.17%

facts.name: Monthly Policy Charge Amount
facts.sentence: The monthly policy charge is $9.

facts.name: Cost Based on Attained Age
facts.sentence: The cost of insurance is calculated monthly based on attained age.

facts.name: Cost of Insurance Calculation
facts.sentence: The cost of insurance is calculated monthly based on net amount at risk.

facts.name: Annual Fund Expense Range
facts.sentence: Fund expenses range from 0.17% annually to 0.85% annually.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: Years 1–5
facts.sentence: A surrender charge of 5% applies during years 1 to 5 of the policy.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: Years 6–7
facts.sentence: A surrender charge of 2% applies during years 6 to 7 of the policy.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Exemption After Year 8
facts.sentence: No surrender charge applies in year 8 or later.

facts.name: Level Death Benefit Selected
facts.sentence: Option I – Level Death Benefit is currently selected.

facts.name: Policy Continuation Beyond Age 95
facts.sentence: If the Senior Lapse Protection Test is satisfied, the policy remains in force until age 95.

facts.name: Senior Lapse Protection
facts.sentence: The policy remains in force until age 95 regardless of account value if the Senior Lapse Protection Test is satisfied.

facts.name: Policy Lapse Due to Debt Exceedance
facts.sentence: The policy may lapse prior to age 95 if policy debt exceeds rider limits.

facts.name: Option II Age Limitation
facts.sentence: Option II cannot be elected after attained age 80.

facts.name: Face Amount Reductions Allowed
facts.sentence: Face amount decreases are permitted after policy year 2.

facts.name: Minimum Face Amount Post-Year 2
facts.sentence: After policy year 2, the minimum remaining face amount must be $100,000.

facts.name: Duplicate Notice Rider
facts.sentence: Duplicate Notice Endorsement is a rider available under Section 5.

facts.name: Fixed Medical Expense Rider Availability
facts.sentence: Fixed Medical Expense Rider is a rider available under Section 5.

facts.name: Policy Value Stabilization Credit
facts.sentence: Policy Value Stabilization Credit is a service feature available under Section 5.

facts.name: Max Policy Loan Limit
facts.sentence: Maximum policy loan is 85% of surrender value.

facts.name: Fixed Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Policy loans carry a fixed interest rate of 4.85%.

facts.name: Loan Threshold & Lapse Protection
facts.sentence: Loans may terminate lapse protection if indebtedness exceeds the rider threshold.

facts.name: Minimum Withdrawal Amount
facts.sentence: Minimum partial withdrawal amount is $1,500.

facts.name: Max Partial Withdrawal Limit
facts.sentence: Maximum partial withdrawal is equal to account value minus required reserves.

facts.name: Partial Withdrawals Reduce Face Amount
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals reduce the face amount of the policy.

facts.name: Withdrawals End Lapse Protection
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals may end lapse protection.

facts.name: Senior Owner Verification
facts.sentence: Verbal confirmation procedures may be required for senior owner protection before processing certain withdrawal requests.

facts.name: Policy Lapse Without Protection
facts.sentence: If lapse protection is not in effect, the policy lapses when account value is insufficient to cover monthly deductions after the grace period.

facts.name: Grace Period Duration
facts.sentence: A 61-day grace period applies after notice is mailed.

facts.name: Evidence of Insurability for Reinstatement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within 3 years requires evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Reinstatement Payment Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within 3 years requires payment of required amounts.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Requirements
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within 3 years requires satisfaction of administrative rules.

facts.name: Suicide Benefit Limitation
facts.sentence: Suicide liability is limited to premiums paid less withdrawals and debt if death occurs by suicide within 2 years of issue.

facts.name: Suicide Death Benefit Limitation
facts.sentence: Suicide liability is limited to premiums paid less withdrawals and debt if death occurs by suicide within 2 years of reinstatement.

facts.name: Policy Incontestability After 2 Years
facts.sentence: The policy becomes incontestable after 2 years.

facts.name: Contestability After 2 Years
facts.sentence: The policy remains contestable after 2 years due to nonpayment.

facts.name: Variable Portfolio Risk Disclosure
facts.sentence: Investment performance of variable portfolios is not guaranteed.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Vehicle
facts.sentence: This policy is issued through SilverOak Separate Account S.

facts.name: Owner Bears Variable Risk
facts.sentence: The owner bears investment risk for variable options.

facts.name: Review Before Allocation
facts.sentence: Read the prospectus and any rider supplement before allocation.

facts.name: Policy Incontestability After 2 Years
facts.sentence: This policy becomes incontestable after 2 years, except for nonpayment.

facts.name: Suicide Clause – First Two Years
facts.sentence: If death occurs by suicide within 2 years of issue, the policy pays less withdrawals and debt.

facts.name: Suicide Within 2 Years Post-Reinstatement
facts.sentence: If death occurs by suicide within 2 years of reinstatement, the policy pays less withdrawals and debt.

facts.name: Variable Portfolio Risk Disclosure
facts.sentence: Investment performance of variable portfolios is not guaranteed.
